info.title: AGHR Governance Studio API contracts
info.description: Complete implementation contract, not a running API. Canonical baseline: Studio sections 27-36; explicit submit extension: workflow 37 step 6. Contract verification does not qualify the engine, hosts or release.

x-authentication: Ephemeral startup credential bound to a server-resolved principal. Never accept request-body actor/authority claims. Browser WebSocket clients without X-Studio-Token support use authenticated GET polling; no URL token fallback.
